title: Fake IRS impostor call
subtitle: Two-voice synthetic recording (Piper TTS), run through the live AssemblyAI pipeline
scenarioAdvice: Hang up. Real government agencies never demand immediate payment by phone, never ask for gift cards or wire transfers, and never threaten arrest for not paying on the spot. Look up the agency's real number yourself and call it.
explanation: This matches the known scam pattern 'Government impostor' (51% confidence). Main red flags: isolation tactics and time pressure. Speaker A is running a pressure script (100/100). Do not pay anything and do not share codes, PINs or account numbers. Hang up.
